title: Predictivity and Utility of Neural Surrogates of Multiscale PDEs
summary: Scientific machine learning is increasingly being spoken of as universal emulators for classical numerical solvers for multi-scale partial differential equations, but most apparent successes can be explained by facts that also define their limits. Many successful benchmarks live on low-dimensional solution manifolds where any competent reduced model will interpolate well. More fundamentally, neural surrogates systematically under-resolve high-frequency content due to spectral bias, and coarse-graining compounds this problem through irreversible information loss.
